2603.18000 AgentFactory (seat Δ8.75): final 41.25 = son55. evidence_level → son55 task. The library is built on Batch 1 and read on Batch 2, but no same-scaffold store-off (AgentFactory on Batch 2 from scratch) is reported. Opus Batch 1 already halves orchestrator tokens before any reuse (4324 vs 8298), and the metric excludes subagent-internal LLM calls, so an accounting shift is not ruled out. Unlike the SWE-Exp k=0 precedent, there is no same-scaffold control, so 'retained' is not earned. M → son55 2 (no separating prediction against the named Voyager code library). E.causality → son55 1. Domain → sol (H07 only; H12 is the less specific card for the same repair step). Shared correction: 'We ensure that all tasks are completed without runtime errors' also hides any reruns from the failure denominator.

2603.18620 LSE (Δ1.25): final 61.25 = son55. E.holdout → son55 1: improver train/eval domains are disjoint and checkpoints are chosen on a separate dev set, but every headline is best-of-25 on the same 50-problem D that drives UCB. Opus adds that batch/D disjointness is unstated, while the summaries carry ground-truth answers and evolved MMLU instructions contain answer-level facts. E.causality → son55 2: trained-vs-untrained in the same loop is clean, but the reward ablation is BIRD-only and nothing separates feedback-driven evolution from a learned static instruction. The Arctic transfer has no untrained-improver arm, and RL training cost is unpriced against the untrained baselines.

2603.23129 Polaris (seat Δ15): final 45.0 (sol 57.5 / son55 42.5). evidence_level → son55 task: runs are labelled 'Successful' by test improvement, the headline is the maximum over successful runs, and best-so-far is read off the test curve. Patch integration has no performance gate, so the test set is the only selection set (EVIDENCE rule 2). RS → sol outside_taxonomy: assumption_audit_and_pivot audits a result's or defence's assumption and re-proves; a context-budget engineering change is a forced low-fit match. son55's RE answers are kept as check questions only. G → son55 2, M → son55 2, E.measurement → sol 3 (A2: son55's grounds are selection/statistics defects charged in E.holdout/E.statistics), E.holdout → son55 1, E.cost → son55 1 (wall-clock/hardware only, per-query cost of evolved multi-response policies absent; r09/r10 precedent). Shared correction: the 'No improvement' threshold is stated as ≤0.8%, but on the 100-item GPQA test 2 samples = 2%. A4: sol local-1..4 and son55 local-1..3 asked different questions under the same IDs; merged by substance (sol local-1 → H12-step4, local-2 → local-3, local-3 → local-1, local-4 → local-2; sol S2 → S4, because S2 is evaluation-budget steering).

2603.23420 Bilevel Autoresearch (seat Δ15): final 47.5 (sol 56.25 / son55 41.25). G → son55 2: the self-referential improver lineage (Gödel Agent, DGM, ADAS) is absent from related work, and the novelty claim is scoped to 'autoresearch systems'. M → son55 2: the generated mechanisms (tabu, bandit, orthogonal) are textbook diversification tools.
